mental_model: AutoVectorizeV2 is the regbase auto-scheduler that decides which scalar/tensor-level linalg work may execute together on the vector unit: it labels and groups fusable ops per device function, computes tile sizes against a byte budget, and expresses tile/fuse/vectorize as a transform-dialect sequence that it executes on a scratch clone of the function. Success leaves vectorized loop nests annotated as outline targets for the pass that follows; failure discards the clone and fails the pipeline instead of silently degrading.
need: The vector cores reach usable throughput only when elementwise chains, interleaves, and reductions run as one tiled loop nest inside a single vector function instead of as separate full-tensor passes over memory. Deciding that grouping is a global, shape- and legality-aware choice that no local rewrite can make, and it must happen while the IR is still tensor-level, before outlining and bufferization fix the memory layout.
responsibility: Per device function: classify fusable vs non-vectorizable ops, form fusion groups (sibling leaves plus absorbed producers) under op-count, stack-slot, conflict, and tree-reduction constraints, estimate tile sizes from the vector-length budget, emit and apply a transform tile/fuse/vectorize sequence, verify nothing vector escaped the outlined regions, and commit or discard the whole attempt.
observable_outcome: A function whose fusable linalg ops become vector ops inside scf.for loops tagged outlined-loop-target-*, which the immediately following OutlineVectorFunctionPass materializes as <func>_outlined_vf_<i> functions and call sites annotated hivm.vector_function + no_inline. Leftover or escaping vector ops fail the pass; on failure the module keeps its scalar form and the pass signals failure.

upstream.entity: canonicalization, FoldExtractInsertPair, SinkOpToConsumerInLoop, manual-scope vectorize (hfusionAutoVectorizePipeline prologue)
upstream.interaction: brings the IR into a canonical tensor-level linalg form so classification and tiling see stable shapes and loop nests

when enableSIMDVFFusion (== enableTritonKernelCompile) it outlines work into private _fused_ functions and freezes per-op tree-reduce selection attrs; AutoVectorizeV2 re-inlines _fused_ callees whose static results exceed 4096 elements (they would overflow UB as cross-VF intermediates), consumes the frozen reduce decisions, and strips those attrs at the end so they never leak into lowered output
flatten/normalize shapes and pre-fuse elementwise ops immediately before AutoVectorizeV2, so group formation starts from few, canonical linalg generics rather than long scalar chains

triggers.entity: hfusionAutoVectorizePipeline (HFusionRegbasePipelines.cpp), reached from buildHFusionPipelines (:562) and buildHFusionRegBasePipeline (:599)
triggers.interaction: when hfusionOptions.enableAutoVectorizeV2 the builder instantiates the pass with AutoVectorizeV2Options (stack limit forced on with multiple-consumer fusion, maxFusedOps, treeReduce, crossIfFusion); otherwise the legacy AutoVectorize branch runs in its place

downstream.interaction: runs immediately after; relies on the outlined-loop-target-* loop labels and the outlinedLoopWithFill marker to outline contiguous loop runs into <func>_outlined_vf_<i> functions and calls annotated hivm.vector_function + no_inline, then strips the labels

when enabled, rewrites the loops AutoVectorizeV2 marked kRegisterTreeReductionLoopAttr into direct register-tree reductions; AutoVectorizeV2's one-tree-per-node rule exists to keep this lowering correctness-safe
convert the vectorized HFusion bodies to the vector dialect, dissolve VFFusion outlines, and pull extract_slices into the already-outlined vector functions

MergeVecScope runs at merge-level 1 before tensor-copy-insertion/OneShotBufferize or at merge-level 2 right after OneShotBufferize, merging exactly the hivm.vector_function callees this pipeline produced; bufferization then plans memory over the merged VF scopes — everything downstream treats outlined VF functions as the unit of vector work

inputs.name: module of device functions
inputs.form: ModuleOp holding hacc device funcs in canonical tensor-level linalg/hfusion form (cube-scope regions present in mixed kernels)
inputs.description: Functions with FusionKind ShallowCV/SingleCube are skipped; cube scopes inside functions are not planned

inputs.name: pass options
inputs.form: vectorLength=256, maxFusedOps=15, enableVFStackLimit, enableMultipleConsumerFusion=true, emitTransformSequence=false, treeReduce, enableCrossIfFusion
inputs.description: provided by AutoVectorizeV2Options from the regbase pipeline builder

inputs.name: frozen tree-reduce selection attrs
inputs.description: written by VFFusionPass on the Triton path, read by shouldUse* helpers during planning, removed again at the end of the pass

outputs.name: vectorized, outline-annotated functions
outputs.form: same functions with fusable linalg ops turned into vector ops inside scf.for loops carrying outlined-loop-target-* attrs (plus outlinedLoopWithFill, unroll_for_vsstb markers)
outputs.description: produced by the applied transform sequence on the committed clone

outputs.name: emit-mode payload
outputs.form: func tagged auto_vectorize_v2.payload.<name> + transform::SequenceOp tagged auto_vectorize_v2.transform.<name>, unapplied
outputs.description: only with emit-transform-sequence=true, for debugging/replay via hfusion-auto-vectorize-interpreter

outputs.name: failure signal
outputs.form: warning 'AutoVectorizeV2 failed;' + signalPassFailure, module left in input form
outputs.description: no silent fallback at this HEAD; the clone is discarded

mechanism.summary: The pass is a plan-then-apply vectorizer: it labels fusable ops, builds fusion groups and tile sizes in an in-memory PlanContext, lowers that plan into a transform-dialect tile/fuse/vectorize sequence, executes it on a scratch clone, and commits the clone only if in-function verification passes. Everything downstream consumes its loop labels and the vector functions the next pass outlines from them.

stages.name: Collect & pre-inline
stages.what: collect device functions (skipping ShallowCV/SingleCube kinds); inline private _fused_ callees with large static results (>4096 elements) into their SIMD callers so big intermediates never become cross-VF buffers

stages.name: Plan on a scratch clone
stages.what: clone the function as cloned_<name>; all planning and transformation happen there; the original is only replaced on full success

stages.name: Label & analyze
stages.what: give every fusable op a unique hfusion-auto-vectorize-target-<n> attr and record loops/shape/bitwidth per op; build the four conflict families (op/sync/copy/group) per block

stages.name: Group siblings & absorb producers
stages.what: group fusable output nodes into FusedNodes, then walk producers upward and absorb each into the best group once all its fusable users are handled; every acceptance re-checks op-count cap, memref-DPS closure, stack slots, vsstb/rank-reduction exclusions, common axis, and conflicts, and keeps at most one split-reduction tree per node

stages.name: Emit tile & fuse sequence
stages.what: per group emit TileUsingForOp (or one of three reduction paths) for each leaf, chain the tiled loops with LoopFuseSiblingOp/LoopFuseNestedSiblingsOp, annotate the fused loop with the node label; fuse labeled producers into the containing loop with MergeProducerExtractUsesOp + FuseIntoContainingOp and run eliminate-single-iteration-scf-for

stages.name: Vectorize labeled ops
stages.what: emit transform::VectorizeOp with the estimated tile sizes for every labeled linalg op and for reduction aux ops (fill/split/combining); interleave/deinterleave are deferred to convert-hfusion-to-hivmave

stages.name: Apply & verify in-function
stages.what: apply the sequence via applyTransformNamedSequence, restore static shapes on the narrowly-guarded softmax accumulator pattern, and run AutoVectorizeVerifier: no vector-typed op (and no leftover labeled linalg/hfusion op) may sit outside an outlined-loop-target region

stages.name: Commit or discard
stages.what: on success erase the original, rename the clone back, topologically re-sort blocks; on failure erase the clone, warn 'AutoVectorizeV2 failed;', signalPassFailure; finally strip the VFFusion cost-selection attrs from the module

control_flow: the regbase pipeline builder decides AutoVectorizeV2 vs legacy AutoVectorize from hfusionOptions.enableAutoVectorizeV2 and always appends OutlineVectorFunctionPass after the V2 branch (AutoVectorizeV2.cpp path only)
runOnOperation drives per-function attempts; each attempt is self-contained and fails independently
planning is demand-driven: leaf grouping first, then producer absorption in a BFS queue ordered by 'all fusable users handled'
the transform interpreter executes the emitted sequence; sequence failure rolls the whole attempt back via the clone discipline
data_flow: labels: op label attrs (hfusion-auto-vectorize-target-N) -> transform MatchOp handles -> loop label attrs (outlined-loop-target-N) -> OutlineVectorFunctionPass VF grouping
tile sizes: shape/bitwidth per op -> node-wide max element byte width -> byte budget split (vectorLength) -> VectorizeOp tile size arguments
conflicts: block-local SSA/memref scans -> per-op conflict sets -> canAccept rejections or dissolvePivot discharges as groups grow
tree-reduce decisions: frozen per-op selection attrs from VFFusion -> tiling path choice -> kRegisterTreeReductionLoopAttr consumed later by TreeReduceV2

provenance.source: bishengir/test/Dialect/HFusion/auto-vectorize-v2.mlir (CHECK expectations read at HEAD 90037fe33; not executed in this analysis)

canonical_example.initial_state: func @triton_add is a device func (parallel_mode=simd) doing two 1-byte GM loads via memref.copy/to_tensor, one linalg.generic that converts i8->f16, adds, converts back, and a materialize_in_destination store; a memref.copy-barrier fixture in the same file has two generic chains separated by a copy
canonical_example.inputs: command line of the test: bishengir-opt %s --hfusion-auto-vectorize-v2 --outline-vector-function
execution_trace: classification: the add generic is a fusable output node; the copy/to_tensor/materialize ops are NonVectorizableOps
planning: one FusedNode per chain; the copy-barrier conflict splits the barrier fixture into two nodes
sequence: tile the generic to the vector-length budget, annotate the fused loop outlined-loop-target-*, VectorizeOp it
outlining (next pass): contiguous labeled loops become @triton_add_outlined_vf_0; the barrier fixture becomes outlined_vf_0 and outlined_vf_1 with separate calls
canonical_example.result: CHECKs expect @triton_add_outlined_vf_0 with an scf.for containing vector<128xi8>->vector<128xf16> casts and 'arith.addf ... : vector<128xf16>', and for the barrier case two outlined functions with two calls
important_states: failure anywhere before commit would have discarded the clone and kept the scalar input
the hivm.vector_function + no_inline annotations on function and call are the contract every downstream VF consumer matches on
boundary_examples: memref.copy acts as a fusion barrier: the two chains must land in different VFs (auto-vectorize-v2.mlir CHECKs)
cross-group-conflict fixture: plans {7,10} and {8,9} would form a circular group dependency and must not merge (auto-vectorize-v2-cross-group-conflict.mlir)

state_transitions.operation: clone, plan, apply transform sequence, verify in-function
state_transitions.after: func @f replaced by vectorized clone (original erased, clone renamed), or original untouched and failure signaled
state_transitions.reason: all-or-nothing per function: planning mutations and transform application are never applied in place

state_transitions.before: fusable ops unlabeled; fused loops unlabeled
state_transitions.operation: planning sets hfusion-auto-vectorize-target-N on ops and outlined-loop-target-N (outlinedLoopWithFill) on fused loops
state_transitions.after: OutlineVectorFunctionPass consumes the loop labels into VF functions/calls and strips outlined* attrs; in-function verifier guarantees no labeled op survived outside outlined regions
state_transitions.reason: labels are the only persistent plan artifact; everything else is expressible as generic transform ops

state_transitions.before: per-op conflict sets where every op is a pivot between upstream and downstream
state_transitions.operation: each absorption calls updateConflicts/dissolvePivot, discharging pivots and adding group-level conflicts
state_transitions.after: conflict sets shrink to genuine post-fusion barriers (sync, copy, cross-node op pivots)
state_transitions.reason: fusion changes who separates whom; stale pivots would over-constrain later grouping

decisions.question: Which auto-vectorizer runs for this kernel?
outcomes: false: legacy hfusion-auto-vectorize with maxVectorizeAxes=2 ('TODO: Remove this constraint after e2e support for multi axes vectorization')
decisions.reason: V2 is the transform-based regbase path; V1 remains the fallback branch behind the same pipeline stage

decisions.question: Is this op vectorization/fusion material at all?
decisions.condition: isFusableOp: linalg::LinalgOp or Interleave/Deinterleave, and not isNonVectorizableOp
outcomes: non-vectorizable (SIMT, matmul-family, sync/copy/shape ops, func.call, ...): stays outside groups and acts as a pivot/barrier in conflict analysis
decisions.reason: groups must map to one vector loop nest; everything else defines the boundaries between groups

decisions.question: May this op join this fused node?
decisions.condition: FusedNode::canAccept: size < maxFusedOps(15), memref-DPS groups closed, stack slots fit, vsstb/rank-reducing exclusions, common axis, no conflict
outcomes: accept: node grows, conflicts updated, group kept contiguous (consolidateToTail)
reject: op becomes its own node (or is refused as producer)
decisions.reason: node size and stack usage directly determine VF codegen cost and legality; conflicts protect ordering and memory semantics

decisions.question: May this producer be fused into a consumer's node?
decisions.condition: not a vsstb-transpose producer; multi-consumer fusion only for linalg::GenericOp producers; not used as DPS inits; wouldBecomeTileLocal/reductionConsumerNeedsFullDomain checks; reduction+broadcast axis guard
outcomes: fuse: producer tiled inside the containing loop (FuseIntoContainingOp)
refuse: producer stays standalone or joins as a fallback leaf
decisions.reason: each refusal cites a concrete downstream limitation (replaceForWithNewSignature supports GenericOp only; memref.alloc inside a VF cannot be outlined; issue 638/3687)

decisions.question: How is a reduction tiled?
decisions.condition: treeReduce option + shouldUseTileReductionUsingForV2 / shouldUseRegisterTreeReduction / shouldUseTreeReduction, and one-tree-per-node compatibility
outcomes: tile_reduction_using_for (default split path with annotated fill/split/combining aux ops)
register tree (loop only marked kRegisterTreeReductionLoopAttr for TreeReduceV2)
tree reduce (power-of-two padding, radix-16 split, <=64 global pairwise tree)
incompatible sibling: kept out of the node entirely
decisions.reason: the three paths trade intermediate materialization vs register-level reassociation; downstream lowering is not correctness-safe with two trees in one containing loop

decisions.question: What happens when a function cannot be vectorized?
decisions.condition: any attempt failure (sequence failure, verifier failure)
outcomes: (historical) before fa682a1a3: retry with MCF disabled and/or fall back to legacy AutoVectorize
decisions.reason: silent degradation was removed deliberately; a failed regbase vectorization must be visible, not absorbed

decisions.question: Plan only, or apply?
outcomes: false (default): apply the sequence and verify
true: tag payload func and sequence (auto_vectorize_v2.payload/transform.*) and leave IR unvectorized for replay via hfusion-auto-vectorize-interpreter
decisions.reason: makes the emitted transform IR inspectable/replayable without re-deriving the plan

constraints.statement: Groups are capped at maxFusedOps (default 15) ops per fused node
When enabled, the VF stack-slot budget (VFStackInfoBuilder, 16-bit slots, i64/index counted 4 slots) bounds group membership; the pipeline forces it on when multiple-consumer fusion is on
memref-DPS (in-place) linalg groups accept no further members
At most one split-reduction tree per fused node; register-tree loops stay dedicated
Sync-block ops, region ops, copies, and GM RAW load/materialize pairs create conflicts that forbid sharing a VF across them
Only device functions are planned; cube scopes (and ShallowCV/SingleCube fusion kinds) are skipped
Dynamic iteration extents are represented as kDynamic, so unrelated dynamic domains may group; a failed loop fusion then rolls back the whole attempt (FIXME, issue 378)
Conflict collection is per-op rather than per-node, which the stack-limit workaround comment flags as defeating conflict analysis for scattered layouts

invariants.statement: The input function is never mutated in place: the attempt commits by rename/erase only after the applied sequence and the in-function verifier both succeed

After the pass, every vector op and every labeled linalg/hfusion op is nested inside an outlined-loop-target region — enforced by AutoVectorizeVerifier inside the pass and again by the standalone verifier pass in the pipeline
Fused nodes stay contiguous and block-ordered; consolidation reports a fatal error (and re-verifies the IR) if the invariant breaks
VFFusion's cost-selection attrs are transient: consumed during planning and removed from the module before the pass returns

assumptions.statement: Upstream passes left canonical, mostly-static linalg forms whose static loop ranges are meaningful tile domains (dynamic extents handled conservatively, see constraints)

boundaries.statement: Elementwise linalg chains, interleave/deinterleave, and reductions (three tiling paths) grouped into tiled, vectorized loop nests with sibling and producer fusion
Dynamic shapes: planned as kDynamic with a FIXME acknowledging unrelated dynamic domains may group and failure rolls back the attempt (issue 378)
SIMT ops, matmul-family ops, sync-block-adjacent pairs, and copy-separated chains are never fused into one VF; non-GenericOp multi-consumer producers and DPS-init producers are refused
Per-op (not per-node) conflict collection is a known soft spot in current HEAD; a workaround disables the stack limit for one large pure-linalg shape instead of fixing the granularity

Whether the V1 legacy fallback described by restrictToFuncNames' option doc is reachable at this HEAD; the plumbing is not visible in the pipeline sources and the fallback was removed by fa682a1a3 (see EV-020)

placement.why_here: It must run while the IR is tensor-level linalg (before HFusionToVector conversion and outlining) and after FlattenOps/PreVectorizationFusion have produced canonical, few-op bodies, because its grouping, common-axis, and tile-size decisions only hold on that form; the loop labels it leaves are the input OutlineVectorFunctionPass requires immediately after
placement.why_not_earlier: Before VFFusion (Triton path) and PreVectorizationFusion there are too many small ops and unfrozen shapes: VFFusion's _fused_ outlining and frozen tree-reduce decisions change the very op set AutoVectorizeV2 plans over, so they must have run first
placement.why_not_later: After vectorization/outlining/bufferization the loop nest and memory layout are fixed; grouping and tiling decisions would no longer be expressible, and MergeVecScope/bufferization need the outlined VF functions to exist
placement.status: derived from pipeline order and gate structure

ownership.files: AutoVectorizeV2.cpp plus the AutoVectorize/ planning directory (PlanContext, FusedNode, FusionUtils, Verify, Attrs, RetriedOptions); OutlineVectorFunction.cpp is the companion pass
ownership.notes: shared reduction helpers live with VFFusion analysis (shouldUse* predicates, VFStackInfoBuilder)

complexity.size: 1672-line entry file + 1506 lines of planning helpers + 218-line outlining pass; ~20 AutoVectorize test fixtures
complexity.provenance: measured from wc -l and test directory listing at HEAD 90037fe33
complexity.drivers: complexity is dominated by legality surface (conflicts, tree-reduce rules, producer guards), not by the transform emission itself

key_takeaways: AutoVectorizeV2 is plan-then-apply: PlanContext decides groups and tile sizes, a transform-dialect sequence applies them on a scratch clone, and the function is only replaced when in-function verification passes — failures are loud (signalPassFailure), not silent fallbacks, at this HEAD.

Labels are the contract: hfusion-auto-vectorize-target-N on ops and outlined-loop-target-N on fused loops are what the transform interpreter matches and what OutlineVectorFunctionPass turns into <func>_outlined_vf_<i> functions/calls annotated hivm.vector_function + no_inline.

The representation change is scalar/tensor linalg groups -> vector ops inside outlined vector functions; downstream (TreeReduceV2, HFusionToVector, MergeVecScope, bufferization) treats those VF functions as the unit of vector work.
Grouping is bounded by more than op count: maxFusedOps, VF stack slots, memref-DPS closure, sync/copy/GM-RAW conflicts, common axes, and one-tree-per-node reduction rules all gate membership.

The VFFusion connection exists only on the Triton-kernel path (enableSIMDVFFusion == enableTritonKernelCompile): large _fused_ results are re-inlined before planning and VFFusion's cost-selection attrs are consumed and stripped.

pass.pass_arg: bishengir-opt --hfusion-auto-vectorize-v2[=vector-length=256|max-fused-ops=15|enable-vf-stack-limit|enable-multiple-consumer-fusion|emit-transform-sequence|tree-reduce|enable-cross-if-fusion]; the pipeline instantiates it via createHFusionAutoVectorizeV2Pass(AutoVectorizeV2Options)
pass.operation_scope: ModuleOp pass (Passes.td:155-176); internally plans per device func::FuncOp, per block under func/for/if/while/scope parents, skipping cube scopes

pipeline_placements.position: after VFFusionPass (Triton path only) / FlattenOps / FuseTransposeIntoLoad / PreVectorizationFusion / PrepareI1Nx1ForVectorization + canonicalization; immediately before OutlineVectorFunctionPass
pipeline_placements.gate: hfusionOptions.enableAutoVectorizeV2 (else-branch: legacy createHFusionAutoVectorizePass with maxVectorizeAxes=2); createAutoVectorizeVerifierPass follows both branches

pipeline_placements.pipeline: HIVM regbase (later stage of the same end-to-end flow)
pipeline_placements.position: bufferizationPipeline places hfusion-merge-vf merge-level 1 before OneShotBufferize (:230-234) or merge-level 2 immediately after it (:256-260) — downstream of the VF functions outlined after AutoVectorizeV2

ir_contract.before: canonical tensor-level linalg/hfusion ops (no vector ops; VFFusion _fused_ calls possibly present on the Triton path)
ir_contract.after: fusable groups are vector ops inside scf.for loops labeled outlined-loop-target-*; the following outline pass materializes each contiguous loop run as func.func <name>_outlined_vf_<i> with call sites, both annotated hivm.vector_function + no_inline (fill VFs additionally kFillVFAttrName); scalar glue, sync/copy ops, and non-vectorizable ops remain in the host function
ir_contract.note: interleave/deinterleave vectorization is deferred to convert-hfusion-to-hivmave; TreeReduceV2 may rewrite marked reduction loops before the HFusionToVector conversion

pass.legality: Membership requires: isFusableOp classification; node size < maxFusedOps; stack-slot fit; common axis; no op/sync/copy/group conflict; no memref-DPS entry into a group; producer-specific guards (GenericOp-only multi-consumer, no DPS-init use, tile-local + reduction-domain checks, reduction/broadcast axis guard, no vsstb-transpose producers); one split-reduction tree per node; cross-if/sync-region barriers respected (wider region scans when enableCrossIfFusion). Rejected candidates stay outside groups or become standalone nodes — rejection is normal control flow, not an error.
pass.rewrite: Not a pattern rewriter: planning builds a transform::SequenceOp (MatchOp-by-label, TileUsingForOp / TileReductionUsingForOp / SplitReductionOp, LoopFuseSiblingOp + LoopFuseNestedSiblingsOp, MergeProducerExtractUsesOp + FuseIntoContainingOp, ApplyRegisteredPassOp, VectorizeOp, interleaved LICM/canonicalize/CSE cleanups) that is applied by applyTransformNamedSequence on a clone, then verified; emit-transform-sequence mode exports the same sequence unapplied for replay.
pass.attributes: Creates hfusion-auto-vectorize-target-<n> (ops), outlined-loop-target-<n> and outlinedLoopWithFill / unroll_for_vsstb / reductionLoop / kRegisterTreeReductionLoopAttr (loops), payload/transform tags (emit mode); consumes kRegisterTreeReductionSelectedAttr/kRegularTreeReductionSelectedAttr (from VFFusion) and removes them plus the module-level frozen attrs before returning; OutlineVectorFunctionPass adds hivm.vector_function + no_inline and strips outlined* labels.
